queue.title: Os juros futuros recuaram nesta 6ªF, acompanhando o maior apetite por risco observado na bolsa, com investidores antecipando posições antes do 1º turno da eleição, apostando em uma vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro. Na agenda do dia, a produção industrial caiu 0,6% em agosto, depois de marcar alta de 0,1% em julho, pior do que a alta de 0,2% esperada pelos economistas, mas confirmando as expectativas de desaceleração da atividade econômica. No fechamento, o DI para janeiro marcava 13,510% (de 13,563% no ajuste anterior); Jan/28 a 13,465% (13,565%); Jan/29 a 13,690% (13,821%); Jan/31 a 13,920% (14,034%); e Jan/33 a 14,035% (14,115%). (*Téo Takar*)

queue.title: EM Assets Find Relief as US Jobs Data Eases Rate Fears
queue.resumo: An index tracking emerging-market currencies climbed to a session high after weaker-than-expected US jobs data prompted traders to scale back bets on another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month. Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 in September after downward revisions to the prior two months, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data released Friday. The figure missed all estimates in a Bloomberg survey of economists. For more, we speak with Anisha Goodly, Fixed Income Managing Director at TCW. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: Former Labor Secretary Rob Reich on Sept. Jobs Report
queue.resumo: Robert Reich, former US Labor Secretary, discusses persistent inflation, very slow hiring, and wages that trail prices. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: Using Decision Science in Investing | Masters in Business with Omar Aguilar
queue.resumo: Barry speaks with Omar Aguilar, CEO and CIO of Schwab Asset Management. They discuss his time at Financial Engines, where he worked under Nobel laureate William Sharpe before joining Schwab Asset Management in 2011. They discuss how his doctorate in decision sciences helps him build trust with clients and push them toward their goals. They also discuss how he built Schwab Asset Management to over a trillion dollars and how he is using his background to help navigate his clients through the current state of the markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
